scope: Read-only independent peer review of failed_clear_feedback; no file in that directory was modified.

core_claim_assessment.safe_geometric_information: supported under the stated accepted-clear model: failure implies source distance >20 m; implementation conservatively applies radius 20-1e-6 and convex-hulls the remaining set.
core_claim_assessment.independent_speed_gain: not resolved; the reported interval crosses zero and the report correctly declines a speed claim.

single_factor_on_off.evidence: run_case creates the same B3 module and config for both arms and changes only geom_failure to arm==on. Case/task construction and observer wrapper are shared.

observer_decision_contamination.evidence: Truth is captured only in the observer closure after original_clear returns and is used only to build event/violation records. In the off arm the hypothetical polygon is assigned only to a local variable; it is never written to solver.polygons. In the on arm solver.polygons already contains the intended geom_failure update. Event lists are not read by the solver.
observer_decision_contamination.boundary: The observer adds real CPU work after failures, but does not change virtual time; both arms completed without timeout and runtime is not used for the claimed virtual-time comparison.

execution_and_denominators.aggregation: Unweighted mean of each case total_virtual_time_s/cleared_count, consistent with repository evaluation convention.
execution_and_denominators.clarification: Pooled source-weighted values are 223.74233672011624 on and 223.7468392456248 off; these are different estimands and are not what the report claims.

confidence_interval.method: 10000 deterministic bootstrap resamples of 200 (exposure_suite, seed) cluster means; each cluster contains 12 scenarios.
confidence_interval.interpretation: Crosses zero; no independently resolved speed benefit.

report_language.evidence: RESULTS distinguishes physical implication, constructed numeric stress, and exposed local closed-loop evidence; states quick negative direction; retains regressions; says no blind/official result; and explicitly says independent speed benefit is unresolved.
report_language.allowed_claim: Failed clear yields safe, sometimes shrinking geometric feedback in the stated model.
report_language.disallowed_claim: Statistically resolved or general Q3/Q4 speed improvement.

caveats.finding: registration.json hashes root evaluation/cases_v1.json and the experimental B3 path, while execution actually loads 最佳方法/数据/exposed_cases.json and 最佳方法/代码/solver.py. The solver bytes are identical and invocation.json seals the actual cases hash, but the 4800-case exposed input was not explicitly frozen in the preregistration.
caveats.impact: Does not invalidate the executed paired result or single-factor isolation, but weakens the claim that the exact full two-batch dataset was preregistered before execution.
caveats.recommended_report_treatment: Keep the existing exposed-regression label and do not describe the exact 2400-pair two-batch dataset as preregistered.
